PASS on the fake backend, final gate run. Served device mhs://localhost/lite3, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0 (the card's floor and the floor of cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1). The model is the card's models[0], Lite3/mjcf/Lite3.xml, read in place from the pinned clone (robots/deeproboticslab/deep_robotics_model/Lite3/mjcf/Lite3.xml; never copied, imported, installed or modified): one free joint (7 qpos, 6 dof), 12 hinge joints (four legs x HipX/HipY/Knee), 12 motor actuators with ctrlrange -30 to 30, and no option timestep in the MJCF. The bridge derives action.ctrl's per-actuator bounds from the model's actuator_ctrlrange; the package writes no Limit of its own. The 2 ms fidelity timestep is MuJoCo's library default because the MJCF states no option timestep; it is published from the stand-in and is not a value of the model file. The fake backend is fake.py, a callable stand-in mujoco module that parses the same MJCF and integrates a placeholder acceleration, so the gate reports the expected simulator-family warnings G6.NOT_RECORDED, G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (ticks, action.ctrl[*] and the reset seed); G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. The card's entry_symbols is empty, so the model files are the entries; all five card models and the seven hint models exist at the pinned commit. No deviation from the card's family-config/MujocoDriver decision. NOT COVERED: MuJoCo itself was not installed and was never run; the fake loads no STL mesh and computes no inertias, contacts, friction, joint limits, gear or actuator dynamics, so its trajectories are not MuJoCo results; no rendering, cameras or sensor streams are served; cap.world.reset.v1 calls mj_resetData and applies no keyframe (the model declares none); one package serves one device, so the clone's M20, M20S, M20_Piper, S10, X30 and two DR02 models are not served; no physical Lite3 is modelled or driven and no hardware run is claimed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null).
